app.title: Invoice Service Admin
login.title: Admin Login
merged.title: Merged invoices
merged.hint: Find invoices by site, buyer code, seller code, and date range (same site/currency/parties), then create a merged document. Voided/reissued invoices are excluded. Edits create a new revision; the original stays unchanged.
merged.candidatesEmpty: No candidate invoices for this filter.
merged.sameGroupRequired: Only invoices in the same currency/buyer/seller group can be merged together.
merged.originalReadonlyHint: The original is not overwritten. Saving creates a new revision.
merged.revisionHint: OTP is required to save. The original/existing document stays unchanged; a new revision number is created.
merged.candidatesRequired: Please set start and end dates.
merged.siteMismatch: Invoices from different sites cannot be merged.
merged.sourceNotEligible: Void, reissued, or deleted invoices cannot be merged.
merged.dateMismatch: Invoices with different issue dates cannot be merged.
merged.currencyMismatch: Invoices with different currencies cannot be merged.
merged.partyMismatch: Invoices with different buyer/seller cannot be merged.
merged.sourceAlreadyMerged: An invoice is already used in another active merge.
lang.label: Language
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.hint: Narrow invoices by site, type, search field, keyword, and date range. Manage: edit, preview, download, regenerate, reissue, delete. Regenerate refreshes the same PDF; reissue creates a new number with the latest buyer/supplier/product (same amount).
invoices.regenerateOk: PDF regenerated. Use Preview or Download to open it.
invoices.editHint: Edit fields except locked ones (number, site, amount, currency, buyer, supplier). OTP required to save.
invoices.editOtpHint: Enter OTP before saving. If Google OTP is off, use Send OTP for an email code. The final editor is recorded in the User column.
invoices.deleteConfirm: Deactivate (soft-delete) this invoice? The row is kept and status becomes Deleted.
invoices.reissueConfirm: Reissue this invoice? A new number is created using the latest buyer, supplier, and product; the amount stays the same. (Use Regenerate to refresh layout only.)
sites.title: Sites
sites.name: Name
sites.deleteConfirm: Delete site {code}? (Sites with invoices cannot be deleted)
sites.deleteHasInvoices: Cannot delete a site that has invoices. Deactivate it instead.
sites.sealsPageHint: For each site, upload the company seal, company stamp, and CEO signature for invoice PDFs. Use the Seal / Stamp / Signature button on each row.
sites.sealsHint: Pick exactly one PDF display mode (never seal + signature + stamp together). Company seal + stamp: place the seal over the Name letters, then stamp on top of the seal (CEO). Transparent PNG recommended.
sites.pdfDefaultsHint: Invoice PDF body and payment phrases are English by default, regardless of admin UI language. Saving applies them to this site's invoices.
sites.pdfRemarksBankHint: Account details (Bank Name, A/C No, Name, Bank Add, Swift) come from the seller party bank info.
sites.pdfNoticeHint: Three Notice presets (e.g. Payoneer) are admin labels only. The PDF heading is always Notice. Empty bank fields are omitted from the PDF.
sites.pdfLineHint: Three presets override Item, Description, and Unit text (quantity numbers stay). Off keeps the original product values. Empty Unit text shows the number only. Hide Unit Price shows — for Unit Price and Unit; Amount still prints.
sites.pdfLineHideUnitPriceHint: When on, Unit Price and Unit show —; Amount still appears (even if unit/price are 0 or —).
pdf.eSignNotice: Notice: This invoice is electronically generated and is valid without a physical signature or company seal.
pdf.simulatorWatermark: This is for testing purposes and is not a formal invoice.
parties.title: Buyer / Supplier / Shared
parties.hint: Register buyers and sellers per site. Shared parties can be used as either buyer or seller in mappings regardless of kind. Contact/signatory name and title are edited on Parties and appear on the PDF. REMARKS/NOTICE visibility is set under Sites → PDF defaults.
parties.bankInfoHint: Empty fields are omitted from the PDF. Stored as structured JSON.
parties.sharedTabHint: Shared parties can be selected as buyer or seller in any site mapping, regardless of which site registered them.
parties.copyHint: All fields are copied. Enter a new code before saving (must differ from the original).
parties.codeLocked: Code cannot be changed when editing.
parties.codeMustDiffer: Code must differ from the original.
parties.deleteInUse: This party is used in a site default mapping. Change the mapping first.
products.title: Product Catalog
products.hint: Add multiple products by product name. Remark appears in the invoice PDF Remark column. Set each site’s default product under Mappings.
products.name: Product name
products.deleteInUse: This product is used in a site default mapping. Change the mapping first.
mappings.title: Site default mapping
mappings.hint: Set the default supplier, buyer, and product for each site. Parties marked as shared can be selected regardless of which site owns them. Buyer and supplier must differ.
audit.title: Operation log
audit.hint: Chronological record of system operations. Invoice issue, reissue, void, PDF, and downloads are logged with who, when, and what. Site, master data, and user changes are included. Export JSON/CSV when needed.
hello.label: Hello
api.error.siteMismatch: Body site does not match API key site

pdf.signBack: * Please send this P/I back with your signature

users.title: Users
users.hint: Only HQ admins can add, edit, or remove users. OTP is required for add/delete/changes. Alias appears in the invoice User column.
users.name: Name
users.resetOtpConfirm: Clear Google OTP for this user? They must enroll again.

platform.testSent: Test email sent (or logged if SMTP empty)

api.error.turnstileConfig: Turnstile is enabled but secret is missing
api.error.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
theme.label: Theme

auth.turnstileWait: Checking for robot access. Please wait a moment.
platform.brandCardDesc: Configure browser tab title, logos, favicon, and LINE/messenger link preview (OG).
platform.tabTitleHint: Shown in the browser tab and bookmarks. Leave empty to use the site name.
platform.authLogoDesc: Shown at the top of the login card.
platform.logoDesc: Shown at the top of the left menu after login.
platform.authMainTextDesc: Optional text on the login screen. Separate from messenger preview.
platform.ogShareDesc: Title, description, and image shown when the URL is shared.
platform.ogTitleHint: Leave empty to use the site name.
platform.turnstileDisplayModeHint: Text: show waiting/done messages only. Banner: show the Cloudflare widget.
platform.footerTextHint: Shown at the bottom of login and admin screens. Leave empty to use the site name.
verify.title: Invoice authenticity
verify.hint: If the four fields below match your document, this is an official issue.
verify.notFoundBody: This invoice token is invalid or the invoice was removed.
manual.title: Operations manuals
manual.desc: Complete Invoice Service operations manual. Opens in a new window with cover and version.
manual.openHint: Click an item to open the manual in a new window. Print / save as PDF is available.
manual.popupBlocked: Popup blocked. Allow popups for this site.
manual.loadFailed: Could not load the manuals module.
updates.title: Update history
updates.desc: Invoice Service release and feature changes. Newest version appears first.
updates.majorRule: Major — login, menu, or integration flow changes
updates.minorRule: Minor — UI, copy, or bug fixes
products.copyHint: All fields are copied. Enter a new code before saving (must differ from the original).
products.codeLocked: Code cannot be changed when editing.
products.codeMustDiffer: Code must differ from the original.
parties.contactHint: Shown on the PDF Messrs block as "Mr. Name / Title".
parties.signatoryHint: Shown on the seller signature block. Site signatory is used only when the party fields are empty.
sites.signatoryFallbackHint: For preview/fallback only. The seller party signatory on Parties takes precedence on the PDF.
sites.pdfSimulatorHint: Simulator PDF defaults. Test disclaimer and SAMPLE stamp can be set independently. When SAMPLE is on, uploaded seals are not used.
sites.pdfSimulatorWatermarkTextHint: Leave empty to use the locale default watermark text.
sites.pdfTermsOfPaymentHint: Shown on the PDF header as Terms of Payment. Leave empty to use the English default (T/T).
sites.pdfSimulatorSampleSealHint: On: grayscale SAMPLE stamp (replaces uploaded seals). Off: real site seals/signature. Turning the test disclaimer on also turns SAMPLE on by default; turning the disclaimer off leaves SAMPLE as-is. Regenerate existing PDFs after changing.
sites.invoiceRetentionHint: Invoices (and PDFs) older than this many days are purged. Simulator site (tinpass-sim) defaults to 3 days. Leave empty on live sites to keep forever.
sites.invoiceRetentionDaysHint: 0 or empty = never auto-delete. Maximum 30 days.
sites.useSharedPartiesHint: Note: parties marked as shared are selectable in mappings regardless of this setting. (Kept for compatibility.)
parties.isSharedHint: When marked shared, the party can be chosen as buyer or seller in any site mapping, regardless of owning site. Enabling share on a buyer opens seller bank fields below.
parties.sharedSellerCardHint: Shared parties are also used as sellers, so enter bank info for PDF Remarks. Contact name/title are also used as the seller signatory.
mappings.sameParty: Buyer and supplier cannot be the same party.
mappings.partyNotAllowed: This party is not allowed for the site (same site or shared party only).
sites.pdfInvoiceLangHint: Invoice PDFs default to English. Keep payment Terms and due text in English here. (Only the admin UI is multilingual.)
merged.invalidDateRange: From date cannot be after to date.
sites.deleteHasMerged: This site has merged invoices. Delete those first.
sites.keyRoleHint: Issue key: creates X-Api-Key and HMAC Secret for API invoice issuance (shown once). List: view key prefixes/status and revoke keys.
merged.candidatesHint: Set site, buyer, seller, and dates, then click Load. Buyer/seller filters use party codes.
merged.selectAllOneGroup: Selected one group only (same currency and party codes). Other groups were skipped.
merged.deletedReadonly: Deleted documents are view-only and cannot be edited.
